title: New understanding joins joy and regret

captions.physics: Answering anew a meaning previously missed
captions.energy: Developing conversation through a living response

meaning: You can answer anew a meaning previously missed and develop conversation through attention to a response, feeling joy in returning coexist with regret about what went unheard earlier.
text: On your Vishuddha, Judgement in the physical position appears in another answer to a meaning previously missed. The Empress in energy supports readiness to develop conversation through attention to a living response and details. Temperance in emotions combines joy in returning with regret about something missed. A familiar remark can receive another answer once its significance becomes clearer. Feelings beside each other require neither devaluing the past nor immediately forgetting discomfort.

For example, you return to “I simply wanted to tell you”. Wanting to share can now receive an answer instead of another proposed solution. **New understanding allows joy together with regret**. Important details gain room previously missing. You can welcome continuation and acknowledge that the first response did not meet the request. Yet later attention requires neither declaring earlier help meaningless nor demanding identical relief. An actual answer gains space without a complete reassessment of the whole conversational history.

Difficulty arises if regret becomes a compulsory introduction to every new question for a pleasant combination of feelings. Living continuation depends on a required formula again. Constructive Empress energy helps develop substance through today’s response rather than repeated confirmation of an earlier inaccuracy. You can recognise missed meaning and continue without a ritual; compatible feelings require no equal measures, while new understanding promises no future ability to hear every wish from its first word.
